g.text: WEB01 - SD3: open a protected module in the shared shell
Route registered only if a loader exists.
Read shared session and required roles
Show permission check; keep protected content hidden
Current user DTO or HTTP error
Section error and retry inside shell
Show feature inside the same layout
Protected error rule for SD2, SD4 and SD5:
when ModuleRequest receives a 401 or 403, ConfirmedModule
awaits refresh(expectedToken) before rethrowing the original ApiError.
The provider rechecks /auth/me via authApi and apiClient.
Other errors are rethrown without a role check. No request is replayed.
